WTO meeting at Cancun
*81. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether a Conference of the World
Trade Organisation was held in Cancun in
September this year;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
issues which were considered in the
Conference;
(c) the major decisions taken in the
Conference and the impact thereof on the
agricultural sector;
(d) how far the outcome of Cancun
Conference been favourable to India;
(e) whether it is a fact that USA
pressurized India to join former's approach
in the Conference;
(f) whether it is also a fact that USA
and other developed countries have agreed
to reduce the subsidies to their farm sector
and market access to their farm produce by
developed countries; and
(g) the action proposed to be taken
including the policy for the next meeting?
Availability of safe drinking water
*82. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that per day
availability of safe drinking water is
extremely limited in the country according
to Census 2001;
(b) if so, the per day availability of safe
drinking water in all 10 lac plus category
cities in the country;
(c) whether it is also a fact that water
supply in many cities falls far below the
national average of 140 litres per capita per
day;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and

26
WIN2/NSESSION\3605RSOE 26
(e) whether there is any time bound
programme to make available safe drinking
water in the Indian cities at par with Sri
Lanka and Malaysia?
Unauthorised tobacco barns in
Karnataka
*83. SHRI  K.B. KRISHNA MURTHY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of unauthorised tobacco
barns in Karnataka;
(b) whether there is any proposal from
Karnataka to regularise these unauthorised
tobacco barns; and
(c) whether in view of the drought in
Karnataka, Government would come to
the rescue of farmers of the State and
allow unregistered farmers to market
their produce at one per  cent service
charge?
Policy for development of tribals
and dalits
†*84. SHRIMATI SAROJ DUBEY: Will
the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any survey has been
conducted by Government in the rural areas
to ascertain where the percentage of tribal
and dalit children is higher;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years;
(c) whether any specific policy has been
implemented by Government to provide
health, education and the opportunities to
move forward to the tribal and dalit children;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Medical degrees from foreign
universities
†*85. SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Medical
Council of India had made it compulsory
for the Indian students who have obtained
degrees from certain foreign universities to
appear in an examination before starting
medical practice in the country;
(b) if so, the names of the countries and
universities in respect of which the decision
is applicable; and
(c) when the said order was issued by
the Medical Council of India and the date
when it came into effect?
Sale of Letrozole in market
*86. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Letrozole, prescribed in the
USA for treatment of breast cancer is being
marketed and used as an infertility cure in
India for the last one year or so;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Controller General of India to this variation
was obtained by the concerned
Pharmaceutical Company and if so, the
details thereof; and
(c) if answer to (b) above be in negative,
the action proposed to be taken against the
company for such a grave lapse?
Uniform media policy
*87. SHRI RUMANDLA RAAMA-
CHANDRAYYA:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Indian Media Group has
raised the issue of a uniform media policy;
and
(b) if so, the action taken in the matter?

Growth rate of Industrial Production
485. SMT. KUM KUM RAI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the annual growth rate of
Industrial production has ever been
calculated;
(b) if so, the annual growth rate during
the years 2000-2001, 2002-2003;
(c) whether Government have identified
the areas with continuous increase in
productions;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the rates where decline in the
production has beenr egistered during the
said period?
Manufacturing of Cheapest CTV and
refrigerators
486. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has
become the cheapest manufacturing base
for colour televisions and refrigerators in the
world, beating even China by a few dollars
in the race; and
(b) if so, the factors responsible for the
progress?
Trade fair in Beijing
487. SHRI MAYA SINGH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a trade fair
of Indian made items was organised in
Beijing recently as a result of follow up action
of Prime Minister's recent China visit; and
(b) if so, the details of the succes
achieved as a result thereof?
Benefits of US generalised system of
preferences
488. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India has managed to
convince Washington to rrestore the benefits
under the US generalized system of
preferences for about 850 agricultural,
chemical and pharmaceutical products from
the country;
(b) if so, whether the US Government

purview of the GSP scheme;
(c) if so, the US Governent's reaction
thereto;
(d)whether the GSP is extended by the
US to 140 developing countries, including
India; and
(e) if so, to what extent this decision has
been implemented and helpful to India?
Growth rate of Industrial Production
489. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the growth rate of industrial
production has declined after 1996-96;
(b) if so, the trends in growth of industrial
production since 1991-92;
(c) the reasons for decline in the
industrial production in recent years; and
(d) the steps taken to boost industrial
production especially capital goods and
consumer durables?
Deeper Economic ties between Idnia and
Germany
490. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Germany is
very keen to develop deeper economic ties
with India;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the anual trade between India and
Germany during the last three years; year-
wise and sector-wise; and
(d)the reasons behind Germany choosing
India, instead of China dn South Africa?
Export of Mangoes from Andhra
Pradesh
491. DR. DASARI NARAYANA RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether mangoes produced in Andhra
Pradesh hae tremendous potential for
exports;
(b) the expots of manoges from the State
during the last three years and forieng
exchange earned in US dollar terms year-
wise; and
(c) the incentives Government have
extended for the growht of mango production
in Andhra Pradesh?
Export of Spices
492. DR. DASARI NARAYANA RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Southern
States of the country are major spices
supplying States for export of spices;
(b) if so, the details of the contribution
made by the Southern States in export of
spices during the last three years, year wise
and State-wise; and
(c) the steps the spices Board and
Governemnt have taken to boost production
of spciesin Southern States so that more
exports of spices are made?
Opening of Nathula Pass for commerial
purpose
493. SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) by when the silk route through
Nathula Pass in Sikkim would be fully
opened  for commerial purpose;
(b) whether Governemnt would talk with
China for opening the 4th commercial route
via Arunachal Pradesh by still wel Road;
and
